cohort: The study utilized fast-proliferating human placenta-derived mesenchymal stem cells (PDMSCs) cultured under various hyaluronan conditions.
finding: Fast-proliferating PDMSCs cultured on low-concentration SHA (SHA0.001) exhibited reduced mitochondrial mass, lower mitochondrial DNA copy number, and lower oxygen consumption rate, coupled with increased ATP content and lactate production, suggesting a hyaluronan-induced mitochondrial functional switch to glycolysis.
